art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Malzahar is an adult Void prophet with a purple hood, wrapped lower face, luminous blue-violet eyes, and gold-trimmed layered robes. Preserve his fully covered face and elongated ceremonial silhouette with opaque sleeves, trousers, gloves, and boots rather than exposed skin. One separate voidling companion has clean segmented chitin and distinct legs, with a closed mouth and no swarm, decay, or threatening jaws.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: purple, gold, blue-violet eyes, pale stone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
